task_title: Implement pre post FFT spectrum overlay visualizer
acceptance_criteria: Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.h and Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.cpp exist and declare/define class SpectrumOverlay deriving from juce::Component
SpectrumOverlay computes a 512-bin (FFT order 9) Welch-windowed, time-averaged spectrum and draws overlaid pre and post curves
SpectrumOverlay drains sample data only through a lock-free FIFO and never locks or calls the audio thread

I will read lines 250 to 400 of `Source/PluginProcessor.cpp` to inspect the processing details where the pre/post drive signal can be routed/copied to the FIFOs.
I will read the rest of `Source/PluginProcessor.cpp` to understand where the pre-drive (before drive stage) and post-drive (after drive stage) signals are processed in `processFloatBlock`.
I will write the `SpectrumOverlay.h` header file containing the `SpectrumFIFO` and `SpectrumOverlay` classes.
I will write the `SpectrumOverlay.h` header file without the ArtifactMetadata since it's a project source file.
I will write the `SpectrumOverlay.cpp` implementation file containing the spectrum analysis math, FFT averaging, logarithmic frequency/dB mapping, and custom grid and path drawing logic.
I will edit `CMakeLists.txt` to register the new `SpectrumOverlay.cpp` file under both the main `ShredBoost` target and the `ShredBoostUnitTests` target.
I will view `Source/PluginEditor.cpp` to understand how the Editor interacts with the Processor.
I will edit `Source/PluginProcessor.h` to include `"UI/SpectrumOverlay.h"`, add public getters for the pre/post FIFOs, and declare the `preDriveFIFO` and `postDriveFIFO` member variables.
I will read lines 420 to 475 of `Source/PluginProcessor.cpp` to locate the exact target range for inserting the FIFO pushes.
I will edit `Source/PluginProcessor.cpp` to reset the FIFOs during initialization in `prepareToPlay`, and to capture/push the pre-drive and post-drive signals to the FIFOs in `processFloatBlock`.
I will view lines 415 to 495 of `Source/PluginProcessor.cpp` to see the exact locations of the `pushToFIFO` definitions and calls.
I will view lines 490 to 520 of `Source/PluginProcessor.cpp` to see the second `pushToFIFO` definition.
I will modify the end of `processFloatBlock` to remove the redundant `pushToFIFO` lambda definition, reusing the one defined earlier in the function scope.

I will view `CMakePresets.json` to check if there is a preset we should use for configure/build.

I will compile the targets to verify our C++ source code.

I will run CTest to verify that all the existing unit tests pass.

I will write the test file `tests/SpectrumOverlayTests.cpp` containing unit tests for `SpectrumFIFO`, the internal FFT `Analyser`, and `SpectrumOverlay` properties.
I will view lines 80 to 95 of `CMakeLists.txt` to find where the test sources are defined.
I will modify `CMakeLists.txt` to add `tests/SpectrumOverlayTests.cpp` to the unit tests target.
I will compile the codebase with the updated CMake configuration to build the new test target.
I will view the beginning of `Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.h` to place the forward declaration correctly.
I will edit `Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.h` to add the forward declaration for `SpectrumOverlayTests` in the global namespace.
I will compile the codebase again with the fix in place.
I will wait for the compile to complete.
I will run CTest to verify that all the unit tests, including the new SpectrumOverlayTests, pass successfully.
I will view `tests/TestMain.cpp` to verify that it executes all defined unit tests.
I will run the test runner executable directly to verify the output of each unit test suite.
I will modify `Source/PluginEditor.h` to declare the `SpectrumOverlay` component as a private member variable.
I will modify `Source/PluginEditor.cpp` to initialize, wire up the pre/post FIFOs to the `SpectrumOverlay`, and lay it out inside the editor's window.
I will compile the plugin again to make sure all editor updates compile correctly.
I will wait for the compile to finish.
I will run CTest one final time to verify that all the unit tests pass.
I will write an artifact report summarizing the implementation details of the pre/post FFT spectrum overlay visualizer.
I have successfully implemented the pre/post FFT spectrum overlay visualizer (Phase G).

Please refer to the [visualizer_implementation.md](file:///home/mike/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/94e8f564-6def-4c93-84e3-3a4c15456da4/visualizer_implementation.md) artifact for a full architectural summary and details on the implementation.

### Key Changes
* Created the **[SpectrumFIFO](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.h#L12-L78)** lock-free SPSC queue and **[SpectrumOverlay](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.h#L80-L157)** visualizer component in **[SpectrumOverlay.h](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.h)** and **[SpectrumOverlay.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/UI/SpectrumOverlay.cpp)**.
* Integrated the pre-drive and post-drive signal capture in **[PluginProcessor.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/PluginProcessor.cpp#L427-L445)** without any lock allocations on the audio thread.
* Configured the **[PluginEditor.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/Source/PluginEditor.cpp#L5-L13)** to instantiate and display the overlaid spectra.
* Added a robust test suite in **[SpectrumOverlayTests.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/shredboost/tests/SpectrumOverlayTests.cpp)** which verifies the lock-free queue, Welch window calculations, and peak frequency estimation correctness.

All unit tests compile and pass successfully. No additional input or action is required.
